name: Oregon
agency: Oregon Department of Transportation (ODOT), Driver and Motor Vehicle Services (DMV)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours with an ODOT-approved driver education course, or 100 hours without; secondary sources say 10 of them at night
teen.nightLimit: Provisional license, first year: no driving midnight to 5 a.m. except home-work, home-school event with no other transport, for employment, or with a licensed driver at least 25
teen.passengerLimit: Provisional license: first 6 months no passengers under 20 except immediate family; second 6 months no more than 3 passengers under 20 who are not family. Not applied with a parent, stepparent or guardian, or a certified driving instructor.
teen.phone: Drivers under 18: no mobile device at all, hands-free included. All drivers: hand-held device ban (ORS 811.507).

notes: Permit supervisor: licensed, at least 21, licensed at least 3 years, in the seat beside the driver.

Knowledge test: commercial sites say 35 questions, 28 correct (80 percent); not confirmed by DMV, so left null. Test offered in Spanish (2025 legislative testimony reports Spanish-language Class C pass rates).
Oregon Driver Manual published in English and Spanish, online, PDF and audio (ODOT manuals page). Direct PDF URLs not confirmed.
Move over (ORS 811.147): move over or slow to at least 5 mph below posted speed; covers any vehicle stopped with hazard lights, flares or an emergency sign (ODOT brochure).
Statutory speeds (ODOT Speed Zones): 20 mph business districts and school zones, 25 mph residential districts, 15 mph alleys and narrow residential roadways.
